front.title: Action Remedy Receipts for Consequential Agent Effects

abstract.t: Revocation cannot undo an effect that already occurred. A dispute does not authorize a refund, return, reversal, or other remedy. This document defines Action Remedy Receipts for recording a bounded dispute decision and a fresh compensating action without rewriting the original action or effect. Every remedy has its own operation identifier, CAID, action digest, authority, consequence owner, and execution result. Indeterminate outcomes remain fenced until authenticated reconciliation.
